title: Caraga poverty rate drops to 7.8% in 2025

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Poverty incidence among families in Caraga (Region 13) dropped to 7.8 percent in 2025, according to preliminary results of the 2025 Family Income and Expenditure Survey (FIES) released on Monday by the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA). The official report, issued by the PSA Regional Statistical Services Office-13 (Caraga), showed that the region’s poverty rate fell by 7.1 percentage points from 14.9 percent in 2023. The improvement brought Caraga much closer to the national average. Across the country, family poverty incidence fell from 10.9 percent in 2023 to 6.4 percent in 2025.
